introHtml: Custom camping wine tumblers are built for the outdoors. Unlike standard wine glasses, these insulated stainless steel tumblers keep drinks at the perfect temperature while withstanding bumps and drops around the campfire. The 10 oz MiiR® Vacuum Insulated Wine Tumbler is a popular choice, featuring a splash-resistant lid and a powder-coated finish that resists scratches. Add your logo with laser engraving or pad printing for a durable, weather-resistant brand impression that lasts through many camping trips.
